text:
HALEWYN, 14 March (Meridian Brief) — Anselm Reyes has been named the new conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra's board announced Friday.

Marguerite Oyelaran, chair of the board, who led the selection committee, made the announcement at a press conference at Calder Hall. She read aloud the board's official press release, issued after a closed-session vote.

Reyes signed a five-year contract, people familiar with the matter said. He was chosen from a shortlist of 31 candidates.

He will take the podium at the start of the 2025-26 season.

The board did not release further details of the vote or the selection process. People familiar with the matter said the committee's deliberations were conducted in private.

Reyes has not yet made a public statement on his appointment.
